name: Iberian domestic league (2025–26)
author: BallGM
description: Eighteen clubs, a 34-round double round robin, eight-team playoffs (best of three, then best of five); no cap, no draft, an open market, FIBA game rules.

fidelity.detail: This league plays four 10-minute quarters; the match engine plays four 12-minute quarters, so per-game totals run about a fifth high. Rates (per possession, per 36 minutes, percentages) compare fairly.
League membership is fixed: the bottom two are not relegated and no club comes up (league membership as an event is a recorded architectural change, not yet built).
No minimum of club-trained players on the game sheet.
Home advantage alternates game by game (1-1-1-1-1), which gives the higher seed games 1, 3 and 5 rather than 1, 2 and 5 in the five-game rounds.
FIBA carries fourth-quarter team fouls into overtime; here overtime starts a fresh count.
